# P.R.O.T.E.C.T Protocol: Challenge Rewards

![P.R.O.T.E.C.T Protocol: Challenge Rewards](/uploads/714_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

**Note (06/19/2026):** The Mr. Fuzzy suit & head (clean), T-51 Abraxo and Brotherhood Protector PA are available until June 23rd. Available again for free in the Atom Shop.

The P.R.O.T.E.C.T Protocol will take place in the week from June 7th, 2026 to June 15th, 2026. 

(P.R.O.T.E.C.T. means: P.ublic R.esponse O.perations T.o E.liminate C.ritical T.hreads)

We receive a free reward in the Atom Shop every day in the game. The goal of the event is to eliminate as many infestations as possible in Appalachia. After clearing 500,000 infestations you will receive the **Brotherhood Protector Power Armor**.

![](/uploads/protect-protocol-teaser.jpg)

Do you think you have what it takes to be an operational scholar, recruit? Time to provide proof of this! The Brotherhood of Steel calls on YOU to maintain order in the wasteland. Log in to Fallout 76 daily from June 7th to June 15th to earn free rewards* and support the Brotherhood of Steel's *Prompt Reactive Operations for the Total Elimination of Chaos and Terror*, also known as the **P.R.O.T.E.C.T. Protocol Community Challenge**!

To prepare you for the P.R.O.T.E.C.T. Protocol Community Challenge, you can pick up free items such as the Clean Mr. Fuzzy Headgear and the T-51 Abraxo Power Armor Paint from the Atomic Shop every day when you log in. Clearing infestations on the map also contributes to completing the Community Challenge. If you manage to eliminate **500,000 infestations** by the end of the challenge, you will receive the big prize as a thank you: the **Brotherhood Protector Power Armor**!

*|*To receive daily rewards, you must (1) own or have access to Fallout 76 and (2) create a Bethesda.net account or log in to your account. Void where prohibited by law.*

In addition, from **08.06. - June 15, 2026** a **Fallout 1st trial subscription!**

![](/uploads/fo1st-limited-preview-in-body.jpg)

### FALLOUT 1ST – LIMITED PREVIEW

Wait, that wasn't all! Take advantage of the **Fallout 1st Limited Preview** for Fallout 76 to enjoy select Premium Membership benefits for free! From June 7th to June 15th, you can activate the Fallout 1st limited preview directly from the Atomic Shop.

During the preview, enjoy benefits such as: Access to the Salvage Crate, which allows you to store infinite crafting supplies, a Utility Crate, which serves as a safe storage place for your precious healing items, a Survival Tent, which allows you to quickly find a place to rest on the move and even fast travel, and a 10 percent S.C.O.R.E. booster!

If you choose a full Fallout 1st membership after the preview, you'll receive even more premium benefits such as exclusive cosmetic rewards, access to your own Private Adventure and Custom Worlds servers, and a free monthly supply of Atoms for the Atomic Shop!

**The Fallout 1st Limited Preview promotion begins June 8th and ends June 15th. To access the preview, you must (1) own or have access to Fallout 76 and (2) create a Bethesda.net account or log in to your account. Void where prohibited by law.*

*Fallout 76 is playable on Steam, Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One, PlayStation®4 and PlayStation®5. Fallout 76 is also available on Xbox Game Pass and PlayStation®Plus Extra. For more news and information, visit Fallout.com!*

Source: bethesda.net

## P.R.O.T.E.C.T Protocol Rewards

### Sunday: June 7th, 2026

Mr. Fuzzy head (clean)

### Monday: June 8th, 2026

Infestation Eliminator Consumables
